rationale.conceptual: The paper applies classical MD simulation, a standard technique, but the reproduction requires careful implementation of specific analysis equations (colour-diffusion counting, Einstein relation for Dp, hopping rate from CTRW, osmotic permeability via collective VACF integration, effective viscosity via stress autocorrelation) and proper system setup. This is an established but multi-part methodology needing thoughtful execution and understanding of the underlying physics and equations.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves building multiple molecular systems, running several 50-ns MD productions (some with static electric fields) using an external MD engine (NAMD/GROMACS/LAMMPS), and performing multiple analysis steps. The orchestration of system construction, GPU-accelerated runs, equilibration, and several post-processing stages with specific file outputs constitutes a multi-stage pipeline with external tool dependencies and data handoffs.
